events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday, known for his work with Monty Python and Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us decades of iconic laughs.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album' on the world. A double LP masterpiece that still sparks debate and adoration. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing remembered
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Today we remember the extraordinary Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago. His voice, showmanship, and legacy continue to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: A true game-changer! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' celebrates its 61st anniversary today. An album that marked a pivotal moment in their evolution.

events.title: John Lennon's passing remembered
events.blurb: Musician, songwriter, and activist John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, passed away on December 8, 1980; he would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. A true icon, forever missed.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: British music icon David Bowie, born on January 8, 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legend David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. His fearless artistry and innovation continue to shape music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, born on January 8, 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: King of Rock's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the one and only Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the world with his iconic sound!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock God Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The guitar wizard behind Led Zeppelin's most iconic riffs. What's your favourite Page solo?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer and songwriter Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! The raspy-voiced legend has given us countless hits across the decades.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs from Madness! The frontman with the iconic voice behind 'Our House' and 'One Step Beyond'.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still loving 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' all these years later.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music singer-songwriter Dolly Parton, born on January 19, 1946, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her music and philanthropic spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Leader's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo success, a true British music icon.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars with his timeless hits today.

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony
events.blurb: The first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 23, 1986, honouring pioneers like Chuck Berry and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Rock History Made
angles.copy: On this day in 1986, rock history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer-songwriter Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's very own Mark Owen! Still bringing the magic after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' Famous Rooftop Concert
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic (and final!) rooftop concert. Imagine being a passer-by that day!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Genesis Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, a true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved English actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Charming Actor's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the ever-charming Hugh Grant! What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Prince's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo stardom, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved English actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy and Inspector Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to national treasure Sir David Jason! A truly iconic figure in British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: On February 3, 1959, rock and roll stars Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Remembering Music Legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago today marked 'The Day The Music Died', with the tragic loss of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on.
